note: `contactId` is required — a get reads one contact; enumeration is persona/contact/list.

Unknown request member — additionalProperties: false catches `includeAnnotations`. Annotations are the holder's and always come back to the holder's own client; there is no switch to ask for them, and none to ask a maintainer to send them anywhere else.
Response without `starred` — an unstarred contact says `false`; absence would leave a consumer guessing.
Response with an empty `lists` — a contact on no list has no `lists` member.
Response with a list name in `lists` — it carries ListIds; a name is resolved through persona/contact/lists/show, so renaming a list touches no contact.
